QUOTE: The interface contract (`include/entropic/inference/tokenizer.h:48`) says empty means "failure or empty input". Callers cannot tell the two apart, and no error code reaches them.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that failure is indistinguishable from empty input. It also shows that callers mostly don't check: "No check", "Silent", and "The others carry on as if the prompt were empty".
